found: Control ruling: /finished is told once per whole sync; the deferral, the union of failed ids across platforms, and the clear at a new whole sync were read against the queue shifting in startTheNextPlatform and found correct (no double tell, no tell while another platform runs).
Found and FIXED: a last queued platform refused for another reason (e.g. missing Meesho panel name) left the sync never told; a fallback tell now fires from followTheNightThrough, once, best effort.
Found and FIXED: sign-in pause and Stop left a stale failed-id list; both now clear it so they never tell (the earlier ruling).
Found and FIXED: the worker.js check for the continuing flag was too weak; it now asserts only the followTheNightThrough call carries it and a behaviour check drives the real flow.

Open notes, accepted: Kartaan no or unreachable on the last platform drops earlier ids (the daily GitHub run is the backup); the hourly re-check racing between a platform end and the next start can lose the earlier ids but still tells.
security: No new data held or sent: the stored list holds report ids only, never the run pass; the send path is unchanged.
could_not_be_checked: worker.js wiring is pinned by text checks only; a live two-platform run is needed to see exactly one tell.
verify_instruction: Reload the extension, paste the run pass from Kartaan's page in the new Kartaan run pass box, press Run now and see the sync start; with the trial ended it should say no and not start.
